name: One-command update streams live
looks: A headline lands with two words in italic colour. Beside it a terminal streams a real update log line by line: backing up, fetching a new version, validating config, rebuilding, finishing on a success line, with a small caption noting it rolls back automatically on failure.
build: list-stack-reveal for the headline; terminal-type-on for the log, each line typing on in sequence rather than all appearing at once, the final success line getting a distinct colour.
sound: A tick per headline word, a steady key tick under the streaming log, and a confirm chime on the success line.
prompt: Show maintenance made trivial: a short headline lands beside a terminal that streams a real update log line by line, each step named plainly, finishing on a clear success line, with a small note on what happens automatically if it fails.
